diagram_previews.alt: A square and a circle with the same centre; each corner of the square sticks out of the circle, and the four corner regions outside the circle are shaded grey. At the top-right corner the two pieces of the sides from the corner to the circle are labelled 3 root 3 minus 3.

The centre O is joined by dashed blue segments to the points X and Y where the circle crosses the right side and to the midpoint F of that side, with a right-angle mark at F; OX is labelled 6, OF is labelled 3 root 3 and FX is labelled 3.
